summary.text: Samir Witta is an unaffiliated candidate for Colorado's 6th District. He is a physician who says he has practiced oncology in Colorado for 25 years and founded nonprofits aimed at helping patients with health costs. He says he is running on health care costs, housing affordability, and limiting the influence of large donors.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he came to the United States 27 years ago; his first job was at a gas station in Washington, D.C.

Earned an M.D. from Charles University in 1990 and a Ph.D. from the National Institutes of Health in 1995, and graduated from the University of Colorado in 2004; his career experience includes working as a physician.
Says he has practiced oncology in Colorado for 25 years and built his own clinic; says 5280 Magazine has named him a top oncologist in the Denver metro area four years running.
Says he founded nonprofits to cover patients' insurance premiums, assembled a team to erase deductibles for cancer patients, and started organizations supporting youth sports and education.
